scope: All105 current additions vowel/shuruq positions, including every lamed ascender and the corrected actual SUS23 occurrence, were freshly inspected above the target letter. This is an additional review angle on the same105 IDs, not new unique positions.
method: Original embedded A2 pixels only, bounded upper frames at native resolution and10x nearest-neighbor, read with the main pass4 source-word context. Each upper frame includes50 source pixels above the located head band and the target head/ascender. Visible existing neighboring holam/shin/sin marks were not reassigned to missing target vowels. Previous-row remnants were distinguished in the word/page context. No OCR, inference from grammar, sharpening, smoothing, reconstruction or another translation supplied text.
